question: Who among the following Indian players has won the Men's Double title in Bangkok Open (Tennis) 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yuki Bhambri and Saketh Myneni.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bangkok Open:-**

 
 
• It is a tennis tournament held annually in Bangkok, Thailand.
 
 
 
• **Yuki Bhambri:-**
 
 
• He is a professional tennis player from India who has won several titles in both singles and doubles categories.
 
 
 
• **Saketh Myneni:-**
 
 
• He is also a professional tennis player from India who has won several doubles titles in his career.

• **Sumit Nagal and Saketh Myneni:-**

• **Yuki Bhambri and Purav Raj:-**
